drivingQuestion: To which guests does Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's permission to eat meat and cheese at one table apply?
outcomeNote: An amoraic limitation of the mishna is stated; nothing is contested within this unit.

segments.he: רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: שְׁנֵי אַכְסְנָאִין אוֹכְלִין עַל שׁוּלְחָן וְכוּ׳. אָמַר רַב חָנָן בַּר אַמֵּי אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא שֶׁאֵין מַכִּירִין זֶה אֶת זֶה, אֲבָל מַכִּירִין זֶה אֶת זֶה – אָסוּר.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: Two guests may eat» together «on» one «table,» this one eating meat and that one eating cheese. «Rav Ḥanan bar Ami says» that «Shmuel says: They taught» this halakha «only» in a case «where» the guests «do not know each other,» as they will not eat of each other’s food. «But» in a situation where «they know each other,» it is «prohibited» for them to eat together at the same table.

moves.cueHe: רבן שמעון בן גמליאל אומר: שני אכסנאין אוכלין על שולחן וכו׳
moves.summary: quotes the clause of the mishna about to be limited
moves.about: re-citing Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's clause of the mishna as the lemma to be commented on

moves.cueHe: אמר רב חנן בר אמי אמר שמואל
moves.summary: in Shmuel's name, restricts the permission to guests who do not know each other
moves.about: Rav Ḥanan bar Ami reports Shmuel's limitation of Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's permission

edges.cueHe: לא שנו אלא שאין מכירין זה את זה, אבל מכירין זה את זה – אסור
edges.about: narrowing Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's permission to guests who do not know one another, since acquaintances may come to eat from each other's food
